# Third-party notices

## Piano specialist

Kong, Q., Li, B., Song, X., Wan, Y., and Wang, Y. (2020).
**High-resolution Piano Transcription with Pedals by Regressing Onsets and Offsets Times.** arXiv:2010.01815.
Original research: https://github.com/bytedance/piano_transcription
Original pretrained weights: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4034264

The original pretrained weights are distributed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
ONNX conversion credited to Mingji Wang: https://github.com/MingjiWang/kong-piano-transcription-onnx
Fixed-window, note-only ONNX export and model mirror: https://github.com/pratham-jain33/kongML-optimized (pinned commit 921b86b73c72161892ee414048792d50de77fafe).

`kong_postprocessing.py` is the unmodified NumPy-only postprocessor vendored by that mirror from Qiuqiang Kong's MIT-licensed `piano_transcription_inference` package. See `KONG-MIT-LICENSE.txt` for the mirror's license and the source file for upstream attribution.

MIDICon changes the inference orchestration: 50% overlapping windows are cross-faded in probability space before note decoding, instead of independently decoding non-overlapping chunks. The extra 251st frame from each 2.5-second export is discarded. The web application uses the note-only export and does **not** claim sustain-pedal detection. No model parameters were retrained or changed.

## Polyphonic engine

Spotify Basic Pitch, Copyright Spotify AB, Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/spotify/basic-pitch
The upstream `nmp.onnx` model (Basic Pitch 0.4.0), `note_creation.py`, and `constants.py` are vendored with their Apache-2.0 license and NOTICE. The only source change is a relative constants import. MIDICon calls ONNX Runtime directly, retaining upstream's half-overlap input padding and 30-frame output stitching, with progress and cancellation between windows. This avoids installing TensorFlow. Basic Pitch is instrument-agnostic and maps its detected notes to piano in this application.

## Original repository

The existing `instrument_agnostic_amt` research package and its documentation are retained. The web application is a separate CPU-friendly interface and does not silently substitute one model for another.

## Demo

`webapp/assets/demo.wav` is an original deterministic additive-synthesis composition generated by `scripts/create_demo.py`. It contains no third-party recording or sample library.
